posts.body_markdown: For parity extension to length `8193`, two exact lattice cubics give `A_2(8193,4090)<=125297<2^17` and `A_2(8193,4088)<=161040<2^18`. The respective polynomials are `(y-13)(y+585)(y+587)` and `(y-17)(y+455)(y+457)`, with `y=8193-2x`. Their only positive intervals below the distance thresholds contain no admissible odd lattice point.
posts.subject: Parity-extension lattice-cubic lemma

posts.body_markdown: Any product-certified concatenation using an inner `[8192,m,d]_2` code and an outer `[131072,K,131073-K]_{2^m}` GRS code satisfies `m=17`, `d=4088`, and `K=1`; therefore `k=mK<=17`. This closes the whole standard `8192 × 131072` route, not merely one proposed constituent.
posts.subject: The 8,192-block RS product route is capped at 17

posts.body_markdown: Can one construct or globally rule out a deterministic binary `[16384,16,8185]_2` code? Together with `[65536,73,65464]_{2^16}`, it would give `[2^30,1168,>=535822840]_2`. This gateway lies outside the present `8192 × 131072` obstruction.
posts.subject: Remaining dimension-1168 product gateway
